messages.subject: Valerie B Oates/NA/Johnson_Controls is out of the office.
parts:
I will be out of the office starting 09/24/2004 and will not return until
09/28/2004.

Johnson Controls Cape Canaveral Operations Building has been evacuated in
anticipation of the potential effects of Hurricane Jeanne. We anticipate
being able to return to work on 9/28/04, but if you are receiving this
message on or after this date, our re-opening might have been delayed.

If you are writing about USGS business, please call Gerry Horak at
970-217-2993, or contact him by email at gerald....@jci.com.

If you are trying to obtain information about HVAC service or supplies or
other Facilities Maintenance requirements through the GSA Schedule, please
call 800-276-5676.

Thank you!
